reference.title: Release Notes
reference.shortdesc: A summary of new features, improvements, and bug fixes in each release of .

ul.li: Added Do Not Disturb scheduling in Notification settings.
Introduced threaded replies: hover over any message and click Reply in Thread to start a sub-conversation.
New Dark Mode theme option available under General settings.
Linux .rpm package now available for Fedora and RHEL users.
Improved message rendering performance for talks with more than 10,000 messages.
Proxy authentication now supports NTLM in addition to Basic auth.
Reduced application startup time by approximately 30%.
Fixed an issue where desktop notifications were not dismissed after reading the message.
Resolved a crash that occurred when uploading files larger than 50 MB.
Fixed incorrect display of timestamps in talks spanning multiple time zones.
Fixed a connectivity issue affecting users behind SOCKS5 proxies.
Resolved a problem where the application would not reconnect automatically after a network interruption.
Fixed a rendering glitch in the Talk Selection Screen on high-DPI displays.
Added file sharing: drag and drop files directly into the talk window to upload and share them with participants.
Introduced emoji reactions: react to any message with an emoji by hovering over it and clicking the smiley icon.
New user status indicators: set your status to Online, Away, Busy, or Offline.
The Leave button now prompts for confirmation to prevent accidental exits.
Message search now supports filtering by date range and sender.
Complete UI redesign with a modern, accessible interface.
Added Direct Messages for private one-on-one conversations.
Introduced talk pinning: pin your most-used talks to the top of the list.
End-to-end encryption for Direct Messages.
Dropped support for Windows 7 and Windows 8.
Dropped support for macOS versions earlier than Big Sur (11.0).
